description: Manages and provides access to the organizational structure and hierarchy within the system.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchy
endpoints.description: Retrieves the complete organizational hierarchy structure.
example_uses: Show me the entire organizational structure.
Can I see the full company hierarchy?
List all organizational units.
Display the current organizational chart.
What is the complete organizational breakdown?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve the entire organizational structure without specifying a particular unit.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchyLegacy
endpoints.description: Retrieves the legacy organizational hierarchy structure. Use this only if specifically instructed or for compatibility reasons.
example_uses: Get the old organizational hierarchy.
Show me the legacy org structure.
Access the historical organizational data.
Retrieve the previous version of the hierarchy.
Can I see the legacy organizational units?
endpoints.when_to_use: Only when specifically instructed to retrieve the legacy organizational hierarchy for historical or compatibility purposes.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchyById
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific organizational unit by ID with complete details including hierarchy information.
example_uses: Show me details for org unit ID 138
Get information about organizational unit 123
What is org unit 456?
Display org unit details for ID 789
Get description of organizational unit 321
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific organizational unit details by ID.

endpoints.name: GetMetadataInfo
endpoints.description: Describes the OrganizationHierarchy entity structure including all field configurations.
example_uses: What fields are available for organizational hierarchy?
Show me the metadata for org units.
Describe the structure of the organization hierarchy entity.
What data can I get about organizational units?
Provide details on the OrganizationHierarchy entity fields.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to understand the data structure or available fields for organizational hierarchy, or to programmatically inspect the entity's schema.
